selection_policy: Prefer higher out-of-fold ROC-AUC; break material ties using F1 and calibration. Never select using training accuracy.
validation: 5-fold stratified out-of-fold predictions; LAD/LCX/RCA/Cath excluded from every input pipeline

LAD.architecture: nested probability blend: Extra Trees + CatBoost + heterogeneous stack

RCA.architecture: nested probability blend: Extra Trees + CatBoost + heterogeneous stack
